title: Paper baseline waits for a snapshot that only its own persona can trigger

prior_review_findings_addressed.p1_missing_source_provisioning_prerequis: Resolved in an earlier delivery under this task (unchanged here): bootstrap now calls source-ingest's own governed persona-source-provisioning/reconcile endpoint directly after Persona creation instead of waiting on the BFF's readback-only reconciler or the source-ingest controller's static desired-state tick.
prior_review_findings_addressed.p2_freshness_gate_bypassed_on_replay: Resolved in an earlier delivery under this task (unchanged here): the source-provisioning call and the snapshot-freshness wait both run unconditionally before any success return in ensure_paper_baseline, including the idempotent-replay path.
prior_review_findings_addressed.p1_pantheon_env_missing_in_actual_contai: Independent review of PR #5958 (head e8d0f1d967) reproduced that docker-compose.yml's source-ingest environment block omitted PANTHEON_ENV, so is_dev_environment() (services/source_ingestion/persona_source_reconciler.py) reads an unset value in the real API container and the dev-only synthetic connector factory never activates, regardless of how correct the reconciler/bootstrap code is. Fixed by adding `PANTHEON_ENV: ${PANTHEON_ENV:-dev}` to source-ingest's environment block (docker-compose.yml), matching the same `${PANTHEON_ENV:-dev}` pattern already used by every other service in the file. The existing non-dev guard (services/source_ingestion/tests/test_persona_source_reconciler.py: PANTHEON_ENV unset/non-dev keeps the requirement unsupported) is untouched.
prior_review_findings_addressed.p2_run_scheduled_nudge_sent_unauthentica: Independent review reproduced that ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready's 404 nudge (scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py) POSTs /api/source-ingest/run-scheduled with no Authorization header, while the real runtime guard (SourceIngestRuntime.run_scheduled_connectors -> _require_controller_authorization, services/source_ingestion/runtime.py) requires controller authorization whenever any controller-owned connector exists -- which the newly provisioned dev-paper-us-equity-simulation connector always is. Unauthenticated, this call now returns 401 on a real host instead of executing the connector, so the snapshot the wait is polling for can never appear. Fixed by threading the same source-ingest controller token ensure_source_provisioning already resolves into ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready (new `controller_token` parameter) and sending it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on the run-scheduled nudge when a token is configured; when no token is configured the nudge is still sent unauthenticated (best-effort, matching prior behavior) and the bounded wait still times out naming the symbol/reason rather than crashing.

owned: docker-compose.yml: added `PANTHEON_ENV: ${PANTHEON_ENV:-dev}` to the source-ingest service's environment block (one line) so the real API container activates the dev-only synthetic connector factory the same way every other dev-tier service in this file already does.

scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready gained a `controller_token: str = ""` parameter, threaded through from the already-resolved source-ingest controller token in ensure_paper_baseline (the same token ensure_source_provisioning uses), and sends it as an Authorization bearer header on the run-scheduled 404 nudge.

implementation.compose_pantheon_env_fix: source-ingest's environment block now includes `PANTHEON_ENV: ${PANTHEON_ENV:-dev}` immediately after PORT, mirroring the identical pattern at 12 other call sites in this file (operator-bff, governance, persona, etc). Without it, os.environ.get('PANTHEON_ENV') is empty inside the source-ingest container regardless of what the operator exports on the host, because docker compose only forwards environment variables a service's `environment:` block explicitly names or interpolates.
implementation.controller_token_threading_fix: ensure_paper_baseline already resolves `provisioning_controller_token = source_ingest_controller_token(env)` for ensure_source_provisioning; that same value is now also passed to ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready(controller_token=provisioning_controller_token). Inside ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready, the run-scheduled POST on 404 now sends `headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {controller_token}"}` when a token is present, `None` otherwise (preserving the prior best-effort, exception-swallowed nudge behavior when no token is configured, e.g. a non-operator-bff caller).

hosted_reproduction.summary: Reproduced the exact gap independent review found and the exact fix, against the real, unmodified source-ingest container defined by this docker-compose.yml (not a mock), in an isolated docker compose project (`-p dpsp-proof001`, unique ports, torn down with `docker compose down -v` afterward). This directly closes AC1's core mechanism and AC4 (no fabrication -- the snapshot came from the real DevPaperUsEquitySimulationAdapter run) on a host with zero preexisting data source instances.
steps: docker compose -p dpsp-proof001 up -d postgres; waited for healthy.
docker compose -p dpsp-proof001 up -d source-ingest-controller-migrate; exited 0, 26/26 migrations ok.
docker compose -p dpsp-proof001 up -d source-ingest with PANTHEON_ENV=dev exported (exercising the just-fixed compose wiring, not a mock); container reported healthy.
GET /api/source-ingest/connectors on the fresh container -> {"connectors": []} (zero data source instances, proving this is a never-provisioned host).

POST /api/source-ingest/persona-source-provisioning/reconcile with Authorization: Bearer <the real controller token read from the container's own /data/source-ingest/controller_token> and a US us_price_daily requirement (the same DEV_US_REQUIRED_DATA_SOURCES shape bootstrap sends) -> summary {"total":1,"satisfied":0,"mutated":1,"skipped":0,"conflicts":0,"unsupported":0}; post_readback.connector_count went 0 -> 1 with connector_id dev-paper-us-equity-simulation, status enabled, metadata.dev_only=true.

GET /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest?symbol=SPY -> HTTP 404 {"detail":{"code":"market_snapshot_not_found","symbol":"SPY"}} (matches ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready's first-run path before any nudge).

POST /api/source-ingest/run-scheduled with NO Authorization header (the exact pre-fix behavior) -> HTTP 401 {"detail":"controller service authorization is required for controller-owned scheduled source execution"}, live-reproducing the P2 defect against the real, unmodified runtime guard (SourceIngestRuntime.run_scheduled_connectors -> _require_controller_authorization).
POST /api/source-ingest/run-scheduled WITH Authorization: Bearer <controller token> (the fix) -> HTTP 200; ran dev-paper-us-equity-simulation to completion, raw_count=2, normalized_count=2.

GET /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest?symbol=SPY -> HTTP 200, symbol SPY, event_time 2026-09-23T00:00:00Z (today, not stale/future), closes=[520.97, 519.34] (>= 2 closes) -- an admissible, fresh snapshot satisfying ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready's is_fresh check.
hosted_reproduction.cleanup: docker compose -p dpsp-proof001 down -v (containers, network, and volumes removed; verified no dpsp-proof001 containers/images/volumes remain).

not_performed.gap: A live first deploy reaching an authoritative paper_running Persona end to end through the full operator-bff/governance/persona/runtime-manager/capital stack (the remainder of AC5's 'completes the governed paper baseline end to end' beyond the source-provisioning/snapshot mechanism proven above).
not_performed.reason: That requires bringing up the full ~30-service docker-compose dev stack (postgres, minio, nats, and every owner service operator-bff depends_on for health) rather than the minimal postgres+source-ingest slice this session brought up to reproduce the exact reviewed defect; it remains a larger shared-infrastructure action than this bounded worker session's proof above, which targeted the precondition-ordering deadlock itself (the thing this task is named for) with the real, unmodified source-ingest runtime rather than a mock.
not_performed.recommended_next_step: A dedicated hosted deploy (or this task's reviewer, if independent verification requires it) should run the unmodified scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py against a real operator-bff container on a host with zero prior data_source_instances and capture the persona reaching paper_running, using the same controller-token wiring and PANTHEON_ENV fix verified in isolation above.

review_decision.note: Independently verify: docker-compose.yml source-ingest now declares PANTHEON_ENV; ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready's run-scheduled nudge carries the resolved controller token as an Authorization bearer header; the new/updated self-tests and compose-activation test genuinely fail without these two fixes (revert them locally and confirm); and evaluate whether the scoped, real-container hosted_reproduction above (zero-instance -> provisioned -> authenticated run-scheduled -> fresh SPY snapshot) is sufficient evidence for AC1/AC4, or whether the still-outstanding full paper_running reach (see not_performed) must be captured before this task can close.
